name: Dalaran Status Report
summary: At Ambermill, the Kirin Tor watch Dalaran as the city is rebuilt in the open. Their report carries intelligence the Deathstalkers seek.

sections.title: Eyes on the Rebuilding City
sections.body: The Scourge sacked Dalaran, and Archimonde brought down its towering spires during the Third War. Early in the rebuilding, the surviving magi removed the city's protective shield and began their work in the open. The Kirin Tor also keeps enclaves such as Ambermill in southeastern Silverpine Forest. Its wizards compile the Dalaran Status Report, which holds intelligence about the city's condition and draws the Deathstalkers' attention.

sections.title: A Deathstalker's Test
sections.body: Lord Varimathras watches for remnants of the Alliance and Kirin Tor, guarding Forsaken control of Lordaeron with constant vigilance. After Forsaken interrogators forced admissions from a captured Kirin Tor mage, the dreadlord ordered the Deathstalkers to secure the report. The document lies in a locked strongbox deep inside Ambermill. For newly initiated rogues, retrieving it is also a rite of passage: a chance to master lockpicking under Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

faq.q: What is the Dalaran Status Report?
faq.answer: The Dalaran Status Report is a set of confidential Kirin Tor documents about Dalaran's condition, recovery work, and current status. Mages at the Ambermill outpost compiled it.

aliases: how to find the status report
faq.answer: The report is locked inside a strongbox in the Ambermill settlement in southeastern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does the Undercity want this report?
faq.answer: Lord Varimathras and the Forsaken see the surviving Kirin Tor as an active threat on their doorstep. The report helps the Deathstalkers assess Dalaran's military strength and secret reconstruction work.

faq.q: How did the Deathstalkers learn about the document?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers learned of the document and its location from a captured Kirin Tor prisoner questioned in the Undercity.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your skill at lockpicking and infiltration under Mennet Carkad by retrieving the report from vigilant mages.
As an undead, you know the Kirin Tor remnants at Ambermill trouble the Forsaken in Silverpine. Intelligence on their operations matters to Undercity's security.
